mapper.insert: INSERT INTO vm_round_models (id, task_id, vm_id, round_number, accuracy, loss, parameters) VALUES (#{id}, #{taskId}, #{vmId}, #{roundNumber}, #{accuracy}, #{loss}, CAST(#{parameters} AS JSON)) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE accuracy = VALUES(accuracy), loss = VALUES(loss), parameters = VALUES(parameters)
mapper.select: SELECT id, task_id, vm_id, round_number, accuracy, loss, created_at, parameters FROM vm_round_models WHERE task_id = #{taskId} AND round_number = #{roundNumber} ORDER BY created_at DESC

SELECT id, task_id, vm_id, round_number, accuracy, loss, created_at, parameters FROM vm_round_models ORDER BY created_at ASC
LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT id, task_id, vm_id, round_number, accuracy, loss, created_at, parameters FROM vm_round_models WHERE task_id = #{taskId} ORDER BY round_number DESC, created_at DESC
SELECT id, task_id, vm_id, round_number, accuracy, loss, created_at, parameters FROM vm_round_models WHERE task_id = #{taskId} AND vm_id = #{vmId} ORDER BY round_number DESC
